description: Source code for API client helpers in the Career Navigator frontend, providing functions for making API requests such as get, post, and managing roadmaps and graphs.

methods.name: buildUrl
methods.description: Constructs a URL with query parameters based on the provided path and params.

methods.name: parseJsonSafe
methods.description: Safely parses JSON from a fetch response, returning null on error.

methods.name: apiGet
methods.description: Performs a GET request to the API, returning a standardized response object.

methods.name: apiPost
methods.description: Performs a POST request to the API, returning a standardized response object.

methods.name: getGraph
methods.description: Fetches a graph data structure from the backend, with optional progress map encoding.

methods.name: createRoadmap
methods.description: Creates or saves a new roadmap via API.

methods.name: listRoadmaps
methods.description: Lists saved roadmaps, optionally filtered by user.

methods.name: getRoadmap
methods.description: Fetches a specific roadmap by ID, optionally scoped to a user.
